idea: Apply evidence-backed mechanisms from arXiv:2607.08716 to make octocode-awareness close its sense-act-learn loop with less bloat

surfacePlan.local: active: current Awareness contracts, schema, CLI, tests, docs
surfacePlan.web: active: official arXiv paper and linked primary artifacts
surfacePlan.github_packages: conditional: only paper-linked implementation or dependency evidence
surfacePlan.goal: a measurable mechanism improvement, not copied terminology
surfacePlan.kpi: new held-out deterministic eval passes; existing package gates stay green; compact output and authority guards do not regress

claims.claim: Selective prompt-grounded intervention is the smallest high-fit Awareness improvement; preserve operational signals/overrides and unchanged-state fingerprints.

events.summary: Apply evidence-backed mechanisms from arXiv:2607.08716 to make octocode-awareness close its sense-act-learn loop with less bloat

Paper defines behavioral state decay and finds maintained memory plus selective grounded intervention most balanced; Awareness already maintains state but notifyGet broadcasts top memories without prompt relevance. Prototype query-grounded reminders with explicit silence and no new storage.
claims: Selective prompt-grounded intervention is the smallest high-fit Awareness improvement; preserve operational signals/overrides and unchanged-state fingerprints.

events.summary: Accepted: reuse Awareness v1 state, select at most one prompt-grounded memory lead with explicit silence, keep operational signals/overrides separate, store no prompt and add no schema/table. KPI moved from 0/4 new held-out checks to 4/4; Awareness 770/770, Pi 214/214 (+2 skipped), smoke and skill review passed. Do not claim the paper's benchmark gains or learned-agent equivalence.
